section: National - new central schemes, missions and their features

accepted.s: Which scheme replaced the Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA) with effect from 1 July 2026?
accepted.x: The VB-G RAM G Act, 2025 replaced MGNREGA with effect from 1 July 2026.
accepted.tq: Use direct old-name to new-name recall.

accepted.s: The VB-G RAM G Act, 2025 was passed in which month and year?
accepted.x: The Act was passed in December 2025 and came into force on 1 July 2026.
accepted.tq: Separate the date of enactment from the date of commencement.

accepted.s:
With reference to the VB-G RAM G Act, consider the following statements:
1. It provides for 125 days of employment.
2. Wages are indexed to the Consumer Price Index for Agricultural Labourers.
3. It came into force on 1 July 2026.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: the Act provides 125 days of employment, indexes wages to CPI-AL, and came into force on 1 July 2026.
accepted.tq: Check each numerical and date statement independently before selecting the complete combination.

accepted.s: Which of the following is a feature associated with the VB-G RAM G Act as reported in current debates?
o: A complete exemption from biometric verification
accepted.x: The Act permits a 60-day farm-season blackout. The other alternatives do not represent the stated features.
accepted.tq: Identify the specific criticism rather than accepting absolute or reversed claims.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding criticisms of the VB-G RAM G framework:
1. Biometric checks may exclude some workers.
2. States bear a 40% share of wages.
3. The framework completely removes the role of technology in worker verification.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Biometric checks may exclude workers and States bear a 40% wage share. Statement 3 is false because biometric checks are part of the framework.
accepted.tq: Find the reversed statement among otherwise related policy features.

accepted.s:
Match List-I with List-II and select the correct answer using the code given below:

List-I (Earlier scheme)
a. Swadhar Greh and Ujjwala
b. Working Women Hostel
c. National Creche

d. Nehru Yuva Kendra Sangathan

List-II (Present status/name)
i. Palna
ii. MY Bharat (IYB)
iii. Shakti Sadan
iv. Sakhi Niwas
accepted.x: Swadhar Greh and Ujjwala were merged as Shakti Sadan; Working Women Hostel became Sakhi Niwas; National Creche became Palna; and Nehru Yuva Kendra Sangathan became MY Bharat (IYB).
accepted.tq: Start from the sure pair and eliminate codes with mismatched renamed schemes.

accepted.s: Swadhar Greh and Ujjwala were merged into which scheme under Mission Shakti–Samarthya?
accepted.x: Swadhar Greh and Ujjwala, both associated with anti-trafficking support, were merged into Shakti Sadan under Mission Shakti–Samarthya.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the merged scheme from similarly renamed welfare schemes.

accepted.s: Working Women Hostel and National Creche were renamed, respectively, as:
accepted.x: Working Women Hostel was renamed Sakhi Niwas, while National Creche was renamed Palna.
accepted.tq: Test the order of two closely related renamed schemes.

accepted.s: Nehru Yuva Kendra Sangathan is associated with which new identity?
accepted.x: Nehru Yuva Kendra Sangathan was associated with MY Bharat (IYB).
accepted.tq: Use direct organisation-to-new-identity matching.

accepted.s: Which one of the following scheme-status pairs is NOT correctly matched?
o: PM SVANidhi — Restructured in 2025 and extended to March 2030
Jal Jeevan Mission — Extended to December 2028
accepted.x: DILRMP is associated with the DILRMP 3.0 guidelines issued on 12 September 2026, not an extension to March 2030. The other three pairs are correctly matched.
accepted.tq: Find the wrong status by comparing the exact extension or guideline detail.

accepted.s: The PM SVANidhi scheme was restructured in 2025 and extended up to:
accepted.x: PM SVANidhi was restructured in 2025 and extended up to March 2030.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the extension year from the nearby scheme-extension dates.

accepted.s: The Jal Jeevan Mission has been extended up to:
accepted.x: The Jal Jeevan Mission was extended up to December 2028.
accepted.tq: Recall the precise month-year endpoint rather than only the year.

accepted.s:
With reference to IVFRT, consider the following statements:
1. IVFRT is associated with the Ministry of Home Affairs.
2. It has been extended up to March 2031.
3. Its extension was reported in April 2026.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: IVFRT is associated with the Ministry of Home Affairs, was extended to March 2031, and the extension was reported in April 2026.
accepted.tq: Combine ministry, endpoint and reporting-date facts without reversing their relationships.

accepted.s: DILRMP 3.0 guidelines were issued on:
accepted.x: The DILRMP 3.0 guidelines were issued on 12 September 2026.
accepted.tq: Use exact-date discrimination among closely spaced current-affairs dates.

accepted.s: Which State received ₹2,545.50 crore under VB-G RAM G?
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh received ₹2,545.50 crore under VB-G RAM G.
accepted.tq: Link the exact financial figure to the correct State.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding Andhra Pradesh in the context of the schemes and programmes mentioned:
1. Andhra Pradesh is a PURVODAYA State.
2. It has 359 Rurban panchayats.
3. It ranked second under MISHTI.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: Andhra Pradesh is a PURVODAYA State, has 359 Rurban panchayats, and ranked second under MISHTI.
accepted.tq: Treat each State-specific current-affairs fact as an independent statement.

accepted.s: Under Deepam-2, eligible beneficiaries in Andhra Pradesh receive how many free LPG cylinders a year alongside PMUY?
accepted.x: Deepam-2 provides three free LPG cylinders a year alongside the Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana.
accepted.tq: Test the exact benefit count in a welfare scheme.

accepted.s: PM-KISAN payments in NTR district were reported to be ₹494.75 crore. This district is in:
accepted.x: NTR district is in Andhra Pradesh, where PM-KISAN payments of ₹494.75 crore were reported.
accepted.tq: Connect the district-specific figure with its State rather than confusing it with a national total.

accepted.s: The extension of PM-KISAN referred to in the current policy context is up to:
accepted.x: PM-KISAN was extended up to 2030–31.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the scheme’s extension period from other March-end deadlines.

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the position of Andhra Pradesh under the PURVODAYA initiative?
o: It is excluded from the PURVODAYA States.
It is identified as a PURVODAYA State.
It is identified only as a MISHTI State and not as a PURVODAYA State.
It is included only under DILRMP 3.0.
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh is identified as a PURVODAYA State.
accepted.tq: Apply the State-specific classification directly to the given policy context.

accepted.s: The Comptroller and Auditor General identified which issue in relation to the Green India Mission?
o: Poor convergence with CAMPA and MGNREGS
Complete transfer of the mission to local bodies
Excessive convergence with CAMPA and MGNREGS
accepted.x: The CAG found gaps in the Green India Mission, particularly poor convergence with CAMPA and MGNREGS.
accepted.tq: Watch for the reversed comparison trap in a criticism-based question.

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: MISHTI — Andhra Pradesh’s LPG distribution scheme
accepted.x: Mizoram was identified as the first fully literate State. Bharat Taxi is the first cooperative ride-hailing platform, while the other two descriptions are incorrect.
accepted.tq: Separate the correct identity from nearby but reversed programme descriptions.

accepted.s: Bharat Taxi is described as India’s first:
accepted.x: Bharat Taxi is described as the first cooperative ride-hailing platform.
accepted.tq: Recall the distinctive first associated with the platform.

accepted.s:
Arrange the following developments in chronological order:
A. VB-G RAM G Act comes into force
B. VB-G RAM G Act is passed
C. PM SVANidhi is restructured
D. DILRMP 3.0 guidelines are issued
accepted.x: The Act was passed in December 2025, PM SVANidhi was restructured in 2025, the Act came into force on 1 July 2026, and DILRMP 3.0 guidelines were issued on 12 September 2026. Within the year 2025, the stated sequence places passage before the restructuring in the intended chronology.
accepted.tq: Use the first and last events, then resolve the middle dates carefully.
